claims.claim: In 2025 there were about 3 hospital admissions a year for every 100 urban residents (all ages, excluding childbirth).
claims.figure: 3.2 urban, 2.7 rural, per 100 persons, last 365 days
claims.source: MoSPI/NSO, NSS 80th round press note, 20 Apr 2026
claims.care: Say admissions per 100 residents; never imply it is their personal risk.

claims.claim: In 2025, the typical (median) private-hospital stay cost ₹24,000 (≈$248) out of pocket, excluding childbirth; the average was ₹50,508 (≈$522).
claims.figure: Private median ₹24,000, mean ₹50,508; all hospitals median ₹11,285, mean ₹34,064
claims.source: MoSPI/NSO, NSS 80th round press note, 20 Apr 2026
claims.care: Lead with the median; give the mean only if asked.

claims.claim: Nearly two in three urban hospital stays happen in private hospitals.
claims.source: NSS 80th round, as reported by ORF

claims.claim: Two in three people killed on Indian roads in 2023 were aged 18 to 45.
claims.source: MoRTH, Road Accidents in India 2023 (OpenCity mirror)

claims.claim: About 1 in 9 Indian adults aged 20 and over has diabetes, and more than 1 in 3 has high blood pressure.
claims.source: ICMR-INDIAB-17, Lancet Diabetes & Endocrinology, Jul 2023
claims.care: Say Indian adults; never imply it is their personal risk.

claims.claim: Employer cover belongs to the employer's group policy; the regulator's option to move it into your own name applies only when you leave the group.
claims.figure: Migration option 'on exit from the group'
claims.source: IRDAI circular IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/003/01/2020 (TaxGuru copy)
claims.care: Say it as reasoning ('which means…'), naming the migration rule.

claims.claim: Moving from group cover to your own policy may be subject to the insurer's underwriting.
claims.source: IRDAI circular IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/003/01/2020 (TaxGuru copy)
claims.care: Say 'may be', never 'will be'; the 2024 Master Circular may supersede this.

claims.claim: A fresh policy bought after leaving a job, rather than migrated, starts its waiting periods from zero.
claims.figure: Credit carries over only by migration or portability
claims.source: IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business, 29 May 2024, paras 11–12 (copy)
claims.care: Say it as reasoning ('which means…'), naming the migration and portability rules.

claims.claim: If you migrate without a break in cover, time served under the group policy counts toward waiting periods.
claims.source: IRDAI circular IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/003/01/2020 (TaxGuru copy)

claims.claim: Of 3.26 crore health claims in 2024–25, 87% were settled and 8% rejected, down from 11% rejected the year before.
claims.source: IRDAI Annual Report 2024–25, as reported by IndiaMedToday

claims.claim: The waiting period for a pre-existing condition you declare can be at most 3 years.
claims.source: Royal Sundaram notice on IRDAI 2024 health regulations

claims.claim: After 5 years of continuous cover, an insurer can't reject a claim for non-disclosure or misrepresentation, except established fraud; policy exclusions still apply.
claims.figure: 60 months (was 96), on the original sum insured
claims.source: IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business, 29 May 2024, para 13 (copy)
claims.care: Never say 'they can't reject your claim after 5 years'.

claims.claim: In 2024–25, about 4 in 10 health complaints taken to the Insurance Ombudsman were resolved in the policyholder's favour.
claims.source: Cafemutual, Jan 2026

claims.claim: Insurers must decide cashless requests within 1 hour; from Aug 2024 to May 2025, 87% met that.
claims.figure: 86.88% of 63,71,620 within 1 hour; 96.69% of final discharges within 3 hours
claims.source: Lok Sabha Starred Question 20, 1 Dec 2025

claims.claim: There is no longer a regulatory maximum age to buy health insurance, though an insurer can still decline an applicant.
claims.source: IRDAI, as reported by Cafemutual

claims.claim: Since Jan 2025, the regulator has capped yearly premium increases for policyholders over 60 at 10%.
claims.figure: 10% annual cap on individual indemnity products
claims.source: IRDAI, as reported by Governance Now

claims.claim: Employer medical plan costs in India are projected to rise 11.5% in 2026, after 13% in 2025.
claims.source: Aon, 2026 Global Medical Trend Rates, India release, 11 Dec 2025
claims.care: Say 'employer medical plan costs', never 'medical inflation'.

claims.claim: In 2022–23, households paid about 43% of all health spending in India directly out of pocket.
claims.source: National Health Accounts Estimates 2022–23, NHSRC/MoHFW, May 2026
claims.care: Give the year and say 'of total health spending'.

claims.claim: Individual health insurance premiums carry no GST since 22 Sep 2025; employer group policies still pay 18%.
claims.source: Department of Financial Services

claims.claim: The tax deduction on premiums (up to ₹25,000, ≈$258, below age 60) applies only under the old tax regime; the new regime is the default.
claims.figure: ₹25,000 / ₹50,000 if senior; Section 126 of the Income-tax Act 2025 from FY 2026–27
claims.source: Income Tax Department, Section 80D
claims.care: No tax advice beyond this claim.

claims.claim: The average health claim paid in 2024–25 was about ₹28,900 (≈$299).
claims.source: IRDAI Annual Report 2024–25, as reported by IndiaMedToday

claims.claim: Ayushman Bharat's base cover goes to families selected mainly from the SECC 2011 deprivation and occupation lists; it is not open to anyone who applies.
claims.figure: SECC 2011: 6 rural deprivation criteria, 11 urban occupation categories
claims.source: National Health Authority, AB PM-JAY

claims.claim: Ayushman Bharat covers everyone regardless of income only from age 70.
claims.figure: ₹5 lakh a year, '70 years and above irrespective of income', approved 11 Sep 2024
claims.source: National Health Authority press release, Sep 2024

claims.claim: The base scheme covers over 12 crore families.
claims.source: National Health Authority, AB PM-JAY

claims.status: Hold (quotes premiums, against hard rules; source Primary, chart undated)
claims.claim: On one major insurer's ₹5 lakh plan in Mumbai, the yearly premium is ₹9,192 (≈$95) up to age 35 and ₹12,590 (≈$130) at 41–45, about 37% more.
claims.source: Care Health Insurance, Care Supreme rate chart; zones per Apr 2026 customer notice
claims.care: Say 'on one insurer's plan'; only to show premiums rise with age, never as a quote or recommendation.

claims.claim: The median employer health cover is about ₹3 lakh (≈$3,100).
claims.figure: Median group sum insured ₹3L; ₹5L at mature companies
claims.source: Plum report (2023), as reported by Outlook Money
claims.care: Name it as a 2023 survey by the insurtech Plum.

claims.claim: Of about 58 crore people with health insurance in 2024–25, only about 6 crore were covered by individually bought policies; 27.5 crore were on group plans.
claims.figure: Group 27.51 crore lives (47.4%), individual 6.01 crore (10.3%), government about 42.3%
claims.source: IRDAI Annual Report 2024–25, as reported by Outlook India

claims.claim: In 2025, 44.3% of urban residents had any health insurance or scheme cover, so more than half had none.
claims.source: MoSPI/NSO, NSS 80th round press note, 20 Apr 2026

claims.claim: The government says health claims are usually rejected under the policy's exclusion clauses, or because the treatment didn't need hospital admission.
claims.figure: No category-wise data kept; Bima Bharosa health complaints 64,365 in FY25
claims.source: Lok Sabha Unstarred Question 5816, 30 Mar 2026 (TaxGuru copy)
claims.care: Never give percentages; it is a description, not a ranking.

claims.claim: When the Insurance Ombudsman issued a formal award on a health complaint in 2023–24, about 6 in 10 went for the policyholder.
claims.figure: Health only: 6,235 awards for complainant, 4,125 for insurer (about 60%); 10,140 mediated
claims.source: Council for Insurance Ombudsmen, Annual Report 2023–24

claims.claim: A ₹10 lakh super top-up above a ₹5 lakh deductible costs about ₹1,900 (≈$20) a year for a young adult.
claims.source: Zurich Kotak Health Super Top Up rate card, Sep 2024
claims.care: On hold: plan variant unclear. Never use at runtime.

claims.claim: Children are usually covered on a parent's family policy only until about 25, or until they marry.
claims.source: Business Standard (Tata AIG sponsored), Aug 2025
claims.care: Name it as an insurer-sponsored article.

claims.claim: Even the government's negotiated rate for an angioplasty is ₹50,800 (≈$525) plus the stent; private hospitals aren't bound by these rates.
claims.source: PM-JAY package rates, Nagaland CMHIS copy
